patterns: APPSC asks only direct current-affairs facts here, e.g. which firm made the first NavIC-based device (Elena Geo Systems, 2023).

Other exams ask for the NavIC full form, the IRNSS orbit split (3 GEO + 4 geosynchronous) with regional, not global, coverage, the GAGAN purpose (accuracy + integrity, not aviation-only) and launch site Sriharikota.

The app goes far deeper (clock failures, NVS-02 orbit, IRNSS-1F 2026 status, SBAS ground segment), mostly in multi-statement format; this is heavier than the APPSC depth but factually sound.
